NIFTY Opening-Range Reversal — v4 exit engine · prem≤0.65 · trail 1.15/0.1 · 15xATR · expiry 13:30

v4 — v2 entry, new exit. Opening range = first 5-min candle (09:15–09:20). 2A — every candle 09:20→t stayed below OR high + down-trend → BUY ATM CE. 2B — every candle stayed above OR low + up-trend → BUY ATM PE. Where NIFTY sits at t does not matter. No confirmation filter — every v2 signal is traded. Trend mode: moderate; nearest expiry.
The entry rule is identical to v2 and every v2 signal is traded. Squared off at 15:00 if still open (expiry-day trades squared off at 13:30). Stop is assumed hit first when one candle spans both levels. Option prices are 1-minute closes; PnL is in option points and in ₹ for 1 lot (65).
